name: Redwoods (Northwood, Monte Rio: MacKenzie's nine in the coast redwood forest on the Russian River)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Northwood Golf Club, Monte Rio CA: narrow fairways cut through second-growth coast redwoods on a bend of the Russian River. Cool, shaded, fog-damp turf in deep blue-leaning greens (G0-G9); the forest floor under the redwoods a red-brown duff of shed needles (F0-F2: woods and out-of-bounds woods, with B0-B2 redwood-bark speckles); the lawns and yards of the river town outside the course a duller green (L0-L2); pale tan bunker sand; the river a cool jade green (W0-W2); grey asphalt for Highway 116 and the cart paths; dark shingle roofs (R0). Trees in assets-src/trees_redwoods.py: coast redwood, bay laurel, bigleaf maple, tanoak. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
